root_cause_label: Fragile Regex Strategy and Incomplete XSS Coverage
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent chose a regex-based XSS filter that is fundamentally incomplete, missing critical attack vectors (iframe, object, embed, base tags), and compounded the problem with repeated Python syntax errors before producing a superficially working but coverage-deficient solution.
t_err_evidence: html = re.sub(r'href\s*=\s*["']javascript:.*?["']', '', html, ...) script written with mixed quotes
t_commit_evidence: The agent commits to the regex strategy in step 2 and never reconsiders it; all subsequent steps (7, 9) merely fix syntax errors while keeping the same incomplete regex approach.
t_surface_evidence: SyntaxError: closing parenthesis ']' does not match opening parenthesis '('
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked the domain knowledge that regex-based HTML sanitization is fundamentally inadequate for XSS filtering; a proper approach requires an HTML parser (e.g., BeautifulSoup). The agent also lacked the Python-specific knowledge of how to properly escape quotes inside raw strings vs. heredoc cat commands, causing repeated SyntaxErrors.
